node.statement: Algebraic conclusion: applying the amplified column identity to V=Z dot X and subtracting twice that equality from the exact amplified Ha equation gives 2*<Y,(Ha^Q_{P,R})_n(Z)X-Z dot X>*u_Q = (Y^dagger dot Z) dot X-Y^dagger dot (Z dot X), by linearity of the sesquilinear form in its second variable.
